messages:
kaya: quick check — prefetcher-3 is dropping spans and I can't stitch traces to logs. I have trace id 0xabc123. Where should I look for the collector logs / sampled spans? Anyone seen this today? :thinking:

alex: first guess: sampling. We run 10% tail-sampling for low-qps jobs; that trace id might not have been sampled. Check Tempo (https://tempo.internal.redwood) and Loki for pod stdout. Also verify otel-collector logs in infra monit. :eyes:

morgan: quick checklist — 1) `kubectl logs prefetcher-3 -n inference | grep "trace_id"` 2) Loki query: `{app="prefetcher",namespace="inference"} |= "trace_id=0xabc123"` 3) Tempo search by trace id. If nothing shows up, check collector sampling config in k8s secret `otel-collector-config`.

kaya: thanks — where's the otel config stored? I only found helm values in the repo.

sam: otel config is stored as a secret in prod (infra manages). I can paste the relevant policy — we use tail sampling that keeps 100% for errors and 10% for successes. Example snippet below (simplified):

```
receivers:
  otlp: {}
processors:
  tail_sampling:
    policies:
      - name: keep-errors
        type: tail_sampling
        decision_wait: 5s
        rules:
          - match:
              any:
                - context: { http.status_code: { range: [500, 599] } }
    sample_percentage: 10
```

morgan: that example is simplified but shows the idea. If your requests are 200s with no error spans, they might be dropped by the sampler. Also note prefetcher uses async workers — if traceparent isn't propagated across a goroutine, you won't see child spans.

kaya: we do pass ctx in most paths but there is one worker spawn without ctx. I'll audit. If I need to force capture, can we bump sampling to 100% for a minute — what's the safest way?

alex: patch the otel-collector config in staging and restart the collector there first. For prod, open a small infra change and request a temporary sample_percentage=100 for 2 minutes. Ping sam for the prod change. Keep an eye on Loki/Tempo ingestion costs.

sam: I can do the prod bump when you say go. Also suggest muting the trace-rate alert during the window to avoid paging.

sre-bot: Deployment rollout detected: otel-collector v2.9.1 -> v2.9.2 at 1945679120 by sam

kaya: doing a staging run now, will ping when I need the prod bump. thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
